titles.title: I Am the Bread of Life

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I am the bread of life
He who comes to me shall not hunger

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
He who belives in me shall not thirst
No one can come to me, unless the Father beckons

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
And I will raise you up
And I will raise you up
And I will raise you up, on the last day

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
The bread that I will give
Is my flesh for the life of the world

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
And if you eat of this bread
You shall live forever
You shall live forever

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Unless you eat, of the flesh of the Son of Man
And drink of His blood, and drink of His blood
You shall not have life within you

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
I am the ressurection, I am the life
If you believe in me, even though you die
You shall live forever
